sections.title: Owner: runs and settings only the owner can do

intro: Admin browser sessions, cPanel, SSH, scripts on the owner's computer. Tools that change data show a dry run first; add `?apply=1` to act. The date is when the item was last confirmed open.

items.text: **Share the inspection report folder** (2026-10-17). Share `My Drive/KOP Inspection Reports` as "Anyone with the link", then `php api/sync-inspection-archive.php apply` on the server and check the dry run lists index entries for every state. Until then the nightly sync drops the archive index of every scraper folder (old 3.3 item 6).

**Severe findings scan cron** (2026-09-29). Add the line in `docs/state-inspection-reports/README.md` in cPanel > Cron Jobs; send the first lines of `/home/kidsover/logs/inspection-highlights-scan.log`.

**Monthly Unsilenced check cron** (2026-09-30). Add as is: `0 4 1 * * cd /home/kidsover/public_html/wp-content/themes/child && /opt/cpanel/ea-php82/root/usr/bin/php api/list-unsilenced-files.php restart --check --minutes=120 >> /home/kidsover/logs/unsilenced-check.log 2>&1`. On its mail, ask a session for the rebuild (old 2, item 10).

**News discovery crontab** (2026-10-13). (a) the 13:30 line loses `--no-facilities`; (b) the 01:30 line gets `--recency 30d` for one night, then loses it; (c) optional: drop `AI_PROVIDER=groq` from both; (d) optional: a third line at 07:30 (old 3.8, old 3.16).
**Drive Sync schedule** (2026-10-17). Keep the nightly `15 3 * * *`, or `*/15 * * * *` for documents within 15 minutes.
**PDF covers** (2026-09-29: 177 left). [regenerate-pdf-previews.php?apply=1](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-content/themes/child/api/regenerate-pdf-previews.php?apply=1) until it reports 0.

**Staff "Former" passes** (2026-10-17, both with exact undo, dry runs done): on the server `php api/fix-staff-unconfirmed.php apply` (2,651 entries on 226 open programs) and `php api/fix-wiki-staff-former.php apply` (29 wiki entries on 21 records).

**Search Console** (2026-10-15). Grant Site Kit the Search Console permission (Settings > Connected services), or export Performance and "Why pages aren't indexed" to Sheets. Then delete `~/kop-gsc.json` and `~/kop-gsc.err` on the server.

**Small cleanups.** Delete the two tokens made under the old GitHub account (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens); remove the duplicate `public_html/.env`; delete comment 453 on [/hyde/](https://kidsoverprofits.org/hyde/) (a staging pingback); clear the leftover `wpdl_anonymous_submissions` row or drop the table; optional: ask NixiHost to purge `SUB-2025-YLVUY0CL` from backups.

**State Lists upload** (2026-10-05). Ask a session for `tmp/state-lists/state-lists.json`, upload it to `~/kop-import/state-lists/` (make the folder beside `kop-import/gdocs`), then review at [KOP Tools > State Lists](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-state-lists).

items.lead: Google Docs export, last two sheets
items.text: **Google Docs export, last two sheets** (2026-10-01). Ask a session for a fresh `tmp/gdocs/export.gs`, paste it at script.google.com and Run once more ("TTI Database - Master" and the 2014 analysis sheet hit Google's rate limit).

**Folders on no page** (2026-10-14). Link "Hyde" (19) to Hyde School (297), "ANASAZI" (214) to Anasazi Foundation (5659) and "Agape Boarding School" (7815) to Agape Baptist Academy (4819) with `api/link-folders.php`, or move the files with the tile pencil.

**Billings Clinic testimony** (2026-09-30). In the [admin data form](https://kidsoverprofits.org/admin-data/), providers tab, MONTANA PROVIDERS > Survivor Testimony: delete the stray paragraph "Medication", tick "OK to publish", save.

**Featured report notes** (2026-09-18). Add a `featured_note` to the two featured UHS of Provo Canyon reports in [manage-featured-inspections.php](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-content/themes/child/api/manage-featured-inspections.php).

groups.title: Scrapers and long runs on the owner's computer

items.text: **PA rerun with OCR version 2**: `python pa_scraper.py --full` (~5,750 documents, ~5.5 s a page, needs 1.5 GB free). Replaces the 164 waiting 2012-17 PA findings (old 3.3 item 5).

**Backfills**: MN with Chrome closed (`py -3 scrapers/mn_scraper.py --backfill-pdfs`, ~20 min); CA is the owner's call (30,885 reports: sync the mirror, then `py -3.14 ca_scraper.py --backfill-pdfs`). Fixed 2026-10-20 in kop-pipeline `c228130`: CCL's end-of-list answer (HTTP 400 "Index out of range") had made every facility count as unfinished, so each run started over. CCL now takes ~1 minute a report page, so the whole walk is closer to 3 weeks than 3-5 days; it resumes, so it can run in evening stretches. GA, TX and CT were started 2026-10-17: confirm they finished.

items.lead: First posts, then publish the page
items.text: **First posts, then publish the page** (run from the launcher): New Hampshire, Wyoming, Idaho, Maine, Ohio, Iowa, Maryland, South Dakota, Virginia (run VDSS again first, and `va_scraper.py --no-post --source dbhds` once from cache), Hawaii, West Virginia (after 2.4's decisions). Colorado: the five steps in `plans/colorado.md` Status on a healthy evening.
**Regular runs**: Oklahoma at least monthly; New Hampshire, Wyoming and Ohio monthly; Hawaii quarterly; WA once with `wa_scraper.py --full` and `KOP_DATA_API_KEY`.

**Unsilenced backup** (once I: has room, ~2.5 days, 118 GB): start `Start-Process python -ArgumentList 'scripts/unsilenced-backup.py','run' -WindowStyle Hidden` in kop-pipeline; keep C: above 4 GB. Then ask a session for the titles and rebuild (old 3.11).
**Document finder retries**: `py tti_doc_finder.py upload --retry-failed` (1,783 failed, 383 waiting).
**Scraper launcher window**: open it and confirm the size and Output pane look right.

items.lead: Try the app on a phone
items.text: **Try the app on a phone** (Expo Go, `npx expo start` in `kids-over-profits-mobile`): a facility with incidents and staff, the Map tab (search, Back, the drawer, Key/List/Timeline), Send (each kind once, check it reaches the Review inbox), Donate, a search for "Copper Canyon".

**Accounts and builds**: an Expo account and `eas build --profile preview --platform android`; Apple Developer (99 USD a year) and Google Play (25 USD) only to publish; ship an EAS update or store build.
**Artwork and listing**: icon, splash, adaptive icon; short and long descriptions, screenshots, age rating; check `/privacy-policy/` covers the app.

items.lead: Site links that open the app
items.text: **Site links that open the app**: after the first real build, the Apple Team ID and the Android signing SHA-256, for a session to ship the two `/.well-known/` files.

**Send to KOP extension**: load it unpacked and send one page; publish `dist/send-to-kop-<version>.zip` to the Chrome Web Store (5 USD) and Firefox add-ons; then a session puts the store links on `/send/`. Safari needs a Mac with Xcode.

intro: Shipped and never looked at on the live site. Signed in unless noted; take each off when it passes.

items.text: **Review inbox**: the page and dropdowns up in a second or two, counts filling in after; cron `kop_review_inbox_counts_cron` in WP-Cron. Page and post drafts: Preview, Publish then Back to draft, Schedule.
**Record cleanup**: the first open of [Record cleanup](https://kidsoverprofits.org/admin-submissions/) works out the cards (~30 s).

**Write-ups**: approve one Woodbury Facts item; it shows under "Approved, held for the write-up" and in the admin-only box on its facility page (not logged out); "Write it with AI", edit, Approve, Undo.
**Records reach pages at once**: approve one article, its facility page shows it; option `kop_resync_keep_underived` is 1.
**Wiki auto updates**: option `kop_wiki_auto_last` shows ~296 baselines, `left` 0, no `errors`; a card appears after the next change to a linked program.

**Status columns**: over SSH, `SHOW COLUMNS FROM lawsuits LIKE 'status'` is varchar(40) and option `kop_status_columns_varchar` is '1'. [Dropdown Lists](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-choice-lists) at 390 and 1280 px: add a test choice, see it, Undo.

items.lead: Card Fields and filing on any record
items.text: **Card Fields and filing on any record**: open the inbox once, then [Card Fields](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-card-fields); on a Websites sent in card, Move to Materials and links on a company, Undo. On a News card, "Connect a record" to a consultant (see it on [/referrers-educational-consultants/](https://kidsoverprofits.org/referrers-educational-consultants/)), Take off. At [/admin-submissions/](https://kidsoverprofits.org/admin-submissions/): Website as a consultant's, Resource for a company, each with Undo move.
**Card add-ons**: on a Nonprofit tax filings card, "Link to a company", pick "New company named ...", check its note and folder, Undo from the Linked tab.

**Admin kit screens**: [Drive Docs](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-drive-docs), [Fornits](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-fornits), [Woodbury Facts](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-woodbury-facts): add one, Undo, cards stack on a phone.

**Volunteer project**: at [Volunteer Reviewers](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-volunteer-reviewers) a 10-item serious-findings project for yourself; answer three in a private window, "Check their calls", Apply one; turn the test volunteer off.

**Pencils**: at [San Marcos Treatment Center](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/san-marcos-treatment-center-tx/), the era pencil, "Renamed, not closed" then Undo, a Fornits thread retitled, an Unsilenced file's title and type. At [Provo Canyon School documents](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/provo-canyon-school-ut/#documents): no stray pencils, "Select documents", move a few, Undo; the same on a company page.

**Lighter pages**: [Provo Canyon School](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/provo-canyon-school-ut/) in a private window: open "more articles" and the Unsilenced groups, pick a document type, print preview.

**Timelines**: [Sequel TSI](https://kidsoverprofits.org/operator/sequel-tsi/), [UHS](https://kidsoverprofits.org/operator/universal-health-services/) (filters, hover and tap cards) and [Sedona Sky Academy](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/sedona-sky-academy-az/). Sequel TSI's history draft shows its tables, at 390 px too.

**Names then on company pages**: [Three Springs](https://kidsoverprofits.org/operator/three-springs-inc/) lists "Three Springs of Courtland" (now Brighter Path Courtland); Sequel TSI lists "Sequel TSI Courtland".

**Investors**: [Investors](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-investors) lists the five imported (check each guessed role and years: Patriot Capital's start, Pine Tree's role); the Investors line on Sequel TSI and one of its programs; link one, Undo; "Altamont" in the header search and at [/?s=altamont](https://kidsoverprofits.org/?s=altamont).

**Directory Editor**: [the screen](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-directory-editor): hide a company, it leaves [/tti-program-index/](https://kidsoverprofits.org/tti-program-index/), Undo; "Every field" and "Edit program" open. Hide one, save it in the admin data form, check `operator.directoryHidden` survives. On the directory: fold two alternate names, Undo; Set company on a row, check the listing and the facility page, Undo.

**Drive Sync**: [Sync now](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-drive-sync) turns to "Reading the Drive folder..." then a report. If it never starts, see `~/logs/drive-sync.log` and fall back to a WP-Cron single event.

**People**: open KOP Tools > People once (makes the tables); after the hourly sync, a person on two programs shows the same "Also worked at" on both; tick "Became an educational consultant" on one, check the facility page; add a relationship between two map people, check both pages and the next map build draws it.

**Data entry changes of 2026-10-14 and 10-17**: KOP Tools > Document Types shows the 7 staff-ideology documents and the editor's notes, retype waiting AI guesses; paste court-order text at /submit-lawsuit/, KOP Tools > Lawsuits and a pending lawsuit card; "Mark as lawsuit news" then Undo; Review inbox > Conflicts (Kind: Type) "Both are right" then Undo; tick two types on a Facilities from News card.

**Discovery and AI**: the nightly discovery log shows "daily list: N records", no 503s and no cron "failed" line on a quota night; [AI Usage](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-ai-usage) names every job (unnamed ones go in `kop_ai_usage_jobs()`). Data audit Waiting and the Conflicts section counted again.
**Inspections**: a VA card at Review inbox > Serious violations opens a Drive PDF.
**Rich Results Test** on a facility and a company page once Google recrawls them.

**Volunteer messages and research projects**: open [Volunteer Reviewers](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-volunteer-reviewers) once (makes `kop_vol_messages`, `kop_vol_answers` and the projects' new `detail` column); make a small "When did these programs close?" project for yourself with a state, open its link in a private window, answer one with a link (it appears waiting in Submissions Review > News), ask a question, answer it under Messages (the menu shows a count, an email arrives), and see the reply marked New on the volunteer page. Mark the answer Used, then close the project.

**"+ Add new..." in dropdowns**: on [Investors](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-investors) pick Kind > "+ Add new...", type a test kind, Add: it is selected and appears at [Dropdown Lists](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-choice-lists&list=investor-kinds); Undo it there. Also the Status dropdown on the admin lawsuits and legislation pages and the Type dropdowns on Woodbury Facts. Selects not fed by a registered list (publication status, jurisdiction, filters) deliberately have no such option.

items.lead: CA and TX onto the shared viewer
items.text: **CA and TX onto the shared viewer**, CA first (9,100 reports held twice under two id schemes; many rows named by facility number). jsdom harness, before/after snapshot; `severe-flags.js` still lands (old 3.3 item 2).

**Poor-scan flag**: show "read from a poor scan: check dates against the PDF" for `categories.ocr_poor_pages` on the Serious violations card and the PA viewer. No plain summaries from PA OCR version 1 text; after the rerun, check a few 2013-16 findings.

**Serious-findings scan coverage**: confirm MI and PA have their extractor rules (plan steps 10 and 11); WA, OR and NV are out for now. Oregon extension (abuse cases, restraint reports) per `plans/oregon.md`.
**Inspection rankings**: look at the screen once prod has counted; a public page ranked within each state; a block on facility and company pages; per-bed rates (old 3.3 item 7).

**Name eras**: rename years into the records (`identification.renamedFrom` / `renamedTo`) so the map draws from them; dated items follow the years (articles, lawsuits, inspections, closures); a name never resolves through another record's names, and Facilities from News offers "Create this name's record" (old 3.7, steps 2-4). Hand-set eras (`kop_name_eras`): into the map build, its sync and `inc/network-rebuild.php`'s fingerprint, and cutting the facility page; company names have no column yet. About 150 past names not on the map have no rename year.

**Data flows** (DATA-FLOWS.md section 4): the operator/company-link writers, the people sync, the memorial, approved highlights and Map Renames/Years fire `kop_record_changed()`; drop the dead `kop_facility_v2_request_sync()` calls, then the 10-minute flush; a nightly drift check screen and `scripts/test-record-events.php`; the smaller items in its section 3 (old 3.17).

**Duplicated fields**: fold note lines repeating a filled field from a second source (171 on 91 records) into one line with both sources; Fornits and Drive Docs auto links still write without a click (old 3.36).
**Held facts**: a record created from a Woodbury card is still public at once; companies' About still comes from notes (needs the same write-up on `kop_operator_page_data()`) (old 3.31).

**Staff**: ~400 wiki staff at open programs whose write-up says "is the ..." (check against each program's staff page, perhaps a Data audit kind); confirm `kop_staff_former_yearly()` ran in early 2027; write past jobs straight to `kop_person_jobs` from Woodbury Facts, the wiki and the data forms, and company people's jobs.
**Wiki staff not merged**: 14 entries whose record is gone, 7 linked to the wrong company, 8 unlinked.

**Data research** (old 3.5): alternate names (4,334 records with none); years that disagree (New Dominion School of Virginia, Withlacoochee JRF, CEDU Middle School, Elevations RTC, Marion Youth Academy, Bartow Youth Training Center, Lexington Academy, Auldern Academy, Three Springs of Englishton Park, Three Springs Paint Rock Valley, Three Springs School of Madison, Oakley School, New Leaf Academy of Oregon); unplaced records (New Directions Home for Boys; "Aspen Education Group #2" 100001, an operator filed as a facility).

**Single records**: Renaissance Center, Fresno (100134: sources, folder, status; empty folders 7765 and 7766 can go); Chicago Lakeshore Hospital (13461) is empty (ProPublica 2018-19, the CMS termination, ALJ CR5480); Newport Academy Alberca's address (10087) reads "1850 Calle Alberc,."; Psychiatric Solutions should list #10370 as Rivendell of Utah; "ClearView Communities LLC" folder (FileBird 92), another company name to look into.

**Provider saves**: a provider project named after a bare state is still filed as a location profile (`saveProjectToCloud` in `js/data-form-modules/api.js`, the state-name override in `api/save-master.php`).
**Program types**: the directory, search and map show the joined string; no per-type filter. **Program homes**: the directory, the map and search still list each home of a grouped program on its own.
**Data model phase 5** (owner first): remove the old model per `docs/DATA-MODEL-MIGRATION.md`, backup first, one step per commit.

**Business filing fields** (`identification.legalName`, `dbaNames`, `registrants`, added 2026-10-20): empty on every record. Fill them from the state business searches the filings research reads (`inc/nonprofit-filings.php`, `docs/claude/filings-research.md`) as a review queue, never unreviewed. Then: registrants who are people get person ids (`kop_people_named_sources()` in `inc/people.php`); a registrant company that is a KOP operator links to it; legal names and DBAs join the name index (`kop_v2_alias_index()`, a "Legal name" / "Doing business as" label in `kop_alias_label()`) so search and the merge matcher find them.

**Admin kit**: the Review inbox (one primary decision, the rest in More; `rinbox-btn-undo` reused for Cancel/Rename/Close); Data Manager and the merge screens; search and paging for Bug Reports, Closure Reports, Facilities from News, Glossary Feedback, Young Adult Programs, Indigenous Schools; the old wp-admin screens; last the `api/*` pages (old 3.25).

Thank you!" (`js/volunteer-review.js:568`) offers the next 10 from the same queue; finished projects close themselves; research kinds can be self-assigned too. d. **Lost link / new device without the owner**: if an email was given, "Send me my link" mails a fresh one; replies to their questions can mail them (opt-in). e. **Questions answer themselves**: each brief shows "Questions others asked" (answers the owner marks "Add to the brief's FAQ"); trusted volunteers can answer; the owner gets one daily digest, not per message. f. **Research answers become one-click edits**: a year/status answer with a link becomes a proposed change card (Apply = writes the field + Undo) instead of the owner editing the record by hand. g. **Briefs for the open queues that lack one**: wiki-staff, young-adult-programs, wiki-updates, wiki-changes, the quote-check half of data-audit and conflicts. Record cleanup: open it or bulk-apply. h. **Close two gaps first**: bar `drive-docs` (quotes the owner's private Docs) and `podcasts` (statements attributed to named people) in `kop_vol_never_sources()`; the data form's "a volunteer checks every suggestion" (`js/tutorial-overlay.js:1172`, `js/data-form/data-wizard.js:610`) is untrue while `data` is barred.
